**Coaching note:**
When your opponent has a loose piece (White's undefended queen on h8) and you're being attacked (your queen threatened by the knight), look for forcing moves that remove the defender. Here, Rxg3+ is check—White must respond to the threat to the king. After the forced Bxg3, you win White's queen outright. The lesson: a forcing check can be more powerful than defending, especially when it removes a defender and wins material.
